glossary.definition: "Women-owned business enterprise" means any individual, partnership, corporation, or joint venture of any kind that is owned and controlled by women who are United States citizens and residents of this state or of a reciprocal state.
glossary.source_title: Section 122.924 - [Former R.C 123.154, amended and renumbered by H.B. 110, 134th General Assembly, effective 9/30/2021] Women-owned business enterprise program.
